authorityReview.evidence: Only inherited nonpayable ERC4626 deposit(uint256 assets,address receiver) is admitted. WrappedOusd extends WOETH and changes only name/symbol; WOETH passes its constructor-configured asset to ERC4626 and does not override deposit. The inherited body max-checks, previews shares, safeTransferFroms the fixed configured asset from caller, mints shares to caller-selected receiver, and returns shares. WOETH conversion/accounting uses rebasing credits and adjuster rather than raw asset balance. Underlying asset configuration, rebasing-credit/adjuster state, conversion rounding/overflow, caller balance/allowance, receiver/token/protocol constraints and governance/upgrades can affect or revert execution. Policy adds no amount, receiver/owner, balance, feed or financial gate; ABI-valid zero/arbitrary receiver and uint256 values remain policy-permitted. Approval is separate, not paired or granted. No current proxy/storage/underlying configuration, liquidity, funded execution, successful transaction, full workflow, or financial safety is established; wrapping produces this vault share, not an issuer redemption or native ETH exit guarantee.

Only inherited nonpayable ERC4626 mint(uint256 shares,address receiver) is admitted. The inherited body checks maxMint, rounds previewed required assets according to protocol conversion, transfers the fixed constructor-configured asset from caller, mints requested shares to caller-selected receiver, and returns assets. WrappedOusd only overrides name/symbol; WOETH's conversion model uses rebasing credits/adjuster. Asset configuration, rebasing-credit state, adjuster, rounding/overflow, caller balance/allowance, receiver validity, governance/upgrades and token/protocol behavior may affect or revert execution. No platform amount, receiver/owner equality, balance, feed or financial gate is added; zero/arbitrary receiver and full uint256 values are policy-permitted subject to contract checks. Approval is separate and not paired/granted. Dated evidence does not prove current proxy/storage/asset configuration, liquidity, funded execution, complete exit, issuer redemption or financial safety.

Only inherited nonpayable ERC4626 withdraw(uint256 assets,address receiver,address owner) is admitted. It max-checks/preview-converts, spends ERC20 allowance when caller differs from owner except unlimited allowance, burns owner shares, transfers the constructor-configured underlying token to the caller-selected receiver, and returns shares burned. WrappedOusd only overrides name/symbol; underlying is fixed by the WOETH constructor argument, not caller calldata. No platform owner-equals-caller, amount, receiver, balance, feed or financial gate is imposed; zero/arbitrary receiver/owner and uint256 values remain policy-permitted subject to protocol checks. Asset/rebase/adjuster/accounting, owner balance/allowance, rounding, governance/upgrades, and underlying-token behavior/availability can cause revert. Approval is not paired or granted. Returned asset is not guaranteed USD/USDC/native ETH or an issuer redemption; no live configuration, liquidity, funded execution, full workflow or financial safety is claimed.

Only inherited nonpayable ERC4626 redeem(uint256 shares,address receiver,address owner) is admitted. It max-checks/preview-converts shares, spends owner allowance when caller differs from owner except unlimited allowance, burns owner shares, transfers computed constructor-configured underlying assets to caller-selected receiver, and returns assets. WrappedOusd only overrides name/symbol and inherits this implementation through WOETH. Policy imposes no owner-equals-caller, amount, receiver, balance, feed or financial gate; zero/arbitrary owner/receiver and full uint256 values are policy-permitted subject to contract checks. Underlying asset configuration, rebasing-credit/adjuster state, owner balance/allowance, conversion rounding, governance/upgrades, token behavior and asset availability can affect or revert execution. No approval is paired/granted. Redeem does not promise USD/USDC/native ETH, issuer redemption, liquidity, successful transaction, complete workflow or financial safety; dated source/deployment observations do not establish current proxy/storage/configuration.
